### Enjoy Life Now, Not Later: Part One
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/enjoy-life-now-not-later-part-one
Passage: Ecclesiastes 11:7-8
Points:
- Life is intended by God to be enjoyed in the present rather than merely endured.
- People mistakenly delay joy while waiting for material possessions, ideal relationships, or accomplished goals.
- Created things and human relationships cannot provide true or lasting inner contentment.
- Joy is accessible today because genuine happiness is bound to the living Lord rather than future circumstances.

### We GET To
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/we-get-to-encouragement-cafe-december-16-2019.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 11:7-8
Points:
- People often rob themselves of joy by dwelling on the past or constantly wishing for the future.
- Simple, ordinary moments shared with others are meaningful gifts worth savoring.
- Life's responsibilities and hardships should not overshadow the privilege of experiencing each day.
- Believers can embrace today with gratitude because God holds both the present and the future.
